## About
Ramsey Automotive is a family-owned shop on S Emerson Avenue. We do honest and professional auto repair and maintenance for the people of Indianapolis and surrounding areas, including Beech Grove and Southport.
Doug, the owner, runs the shop floor, and Jodie helps get your appointment set up. Our ASE certified technicians work on foreign and domestic vehicles, big jobs and small ones.
As a certified NAPA AutoCare Center, we bring you the benefits of a national name while keeping the personal touch of a family business. Neighbors rate us 4.6 from 98 Google reviews.

## Services
- Oil Change: We service all makes and models. While your oil is being changed, we'll also check for any potential problems with your vehicle.
- Brakes: Hearing squeaking or grinding when you stop? Bring it in so we can repair your brakes before they get worse.
- Air Conditioning: We'll fix your A/C so you can stay comfortable while driving throughout the year.
- Preventative Maintenance: We'll help you keep your vehicle in excellent shape so small things don't turn into big repairs.
- Axle Repair and Replacement: Axle repair and replacement on foreign and domestic vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: How far ahead should I book?
A: One reviewer says it's best to call a couple weeks in advance, and that Jodie is good about getting your appointment set up.

Q: What happens after I send an appointment request?
A: The request form doesn't lock in a time, but we will be in touch with you within 24 hours to schedule a time that works well for you.

Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: We're equipped to handle all major and minor repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Where exactly are you?
A: We're on S Emerson Avenue in Indianapolis. One reviewer puts it simply: right between Kentucky Fried Chicken and Waffle House.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
